title: DEPT: Decoupled Embeddings for Pre-training Language Models

layout.note: A 2x2 grid of identical left-to-right pipelines separated by thin cross-shaped rules: STANDARD top left (legend box at its right end), TRIM top right, GLOB bottom left, SPEC bottom right. Small variant tag boxes sit at the centre cross, not above each panel. Each pipeline runs from flag and document icons through a tokenizer and datasets to workers and a server frame; the figure is very wide and low.

lesson: Draw design variants as a 2x2 grid of one identical pipeline, number the steps once and change only the parts that differ (merged versus separate datasets, crossed-out or coloured embeddings, an aggregation equation present or absent), with the legend inside one panel.
